_comment: Every value of ProviderType in proto/panmail/v1/provider_type.proto, and
the only place the two clients' ProviderType constants are written down
together. Each suite asserts its own client exposes exactly these.
This is the kind of provider a listing returns. IMAP and POP3 are in it
because the gateway lists them, but they are mailboxes inbound mail is
read from, not something to send through.
The proto reserves 2 to 5 rather than naming them, so they are not here —
but a stored row may still carry one, and the gateway writes a value its
enum cannot name as a bare number. The clients keep that as its decimal
spelling rather than failing the list.
Generated by scripts/sync-status.py. Do not hand-edit.
UNSPECIFIED is here because the proto has it. As a filter it means no
filter; it is not a kind of provider.
